reason: A mature lavaan CB-SEM fit was completed in an isolated R library under /tmp; project dependencies were not changed.
spatial_inference: piecewise path equations use 5 km block-cluster robust covariance when at least 8 blocks are represented; CB fit indices are naive iid descriptive indices; PLS paths have no bootstrap intervals.

lavaan_cbsem.fit_index_caveat: Conventional iid ML fit indices; spatial dependence is handled only by the separate piecewise path analysis and must be considered in interpretation.

pls_control_expansion.method: Mode-B formative PLS outer weights with single-indicator exogenous controls in inner equations
pls_control_expansion.uncertainty: No bootstrap; path coefficients and R2 increments are descriptive and not spatially robust.

pls_structure_control_expansion.method: Mode-B formative PLS outer weights with single-indicator exogenous controls in inner equations
pls_structure_control_expansion.uncertainty: No bootstrap; path coefficients and R2 increments are descriptive and not spatially robust.
